title: Batched Contextual Reinforcement II: Does RLVR Need Long Rollout Windows?
abstract: arXiv:2610.22887v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Long rollout windows make reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) expensive, yet simply shortening them can remove the correctness signal: when every single-problem rollout truncates before an answer, group-relative accuracy advantages vanish. As a technical continuation of Batched Contextual Reinforcement (BCR), we study how concurrent rewards relax this dependence on long windows. Concurrent Constraint Reinforcement (CCR) places three independently verifiable problems in one capped training completion. Correct answers completed before truncation retain credit, while a shared budget encourages shorter useful reasoning without an explicit length penalty. We connect this mechanism to conditional reward- and update-variance analyses and study 4B and 8B mathematical reasoning models. Against single-problem GRPO with a 32k window, CCR with an 8,000-token window reduces tokens per training step from 975,464 to 174,957 on 4B an

translated_title: 批量上下文强化 II：RLVR 需要长采样窗口吗？
translated_abstract: 长采样窗口使得可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）的代价高昂，但简单缩短窗口可能会丢失正确性信号：当每个单问题的采样在得出答案之前就被截断时，组相对准确率优势将不复存在。作为批量上下文强化（Batched Contextual Reinforcement, BCR）的技术延续，我们研究了并发奖励如何放宽这种对长窗口的依赖。并发约束强化将三个可独立验证的问题置于同一个有长度上限的训练完成中。在截断前完成的正确答案仍可获得奖励，而共享预算在无需显式长度惩罚的情况下，鼓励更简短的有效推理。我们将该机制与条件奖励方差和更新方差分析联系起来，并在4B和8B数学推理模型上进行了研究。与使用32k窗口的单问题GRPO相比，使用8,000-token窗口的CCR在4B模型上将每训练步的token数从975,464降至174,957。
tldr: 提出并发约束强化（CCR），将多个可独立验证的问题放入同一个受限完成中，使RLVR在8,000-token的短窗口下仍能保留正确性信号，并将每训练步的token消耗从约97.5万降至约17.5万，大幅降低训练成本。
en_tdlr: Proposes Concurrent Constraint Reinforcement (CCR), which packs multiple independently verifiable problems into a single capped completion, preserving correctness signals under an 8,000-token window and cutting tokens per training step from ~975K to ~175K, dramatically reducing RLVR training cost.
